About us

Homemade, honest, and baked with love

Homely Bake by Apoorva is an FSSAI-certified home bakery in Noida, baking custom cakes, teacakes and desserts to order. Every bake is made fresh in a home kitchen — no preservatives, no shortcuts, just honest homemade flavour.

Tell us your flavour, theme and date, and we will bake something made just for your occasion.
